FINAL SQL:
SELECT v.ID, v.Name, v.Level_of_membership
FROM visitor v
JOIN (
    SELECT visitor_ID, SUM(Total_spent) AS total
    FROM visit
    GROUP BY visitor_ID
) vt ON v.ID = vt.visitor_ID
WHERE vt.total = (
    SELECT MAX(total)
    FROM (
        SELECT visitor_ID, SUM(Total_spent) AS total
        FROM visit
        GROUP BY visitor_ID
    )
);
